correctness.rationale: The chain Laplacian identity B^T B + D D^T=nI is verified entrywise and yields the exact norm/defect identity. Zero defect is equivalent to a transitive tournament on n-1 labels and yields (n-1)! distinct exposed contacts. The minimum-circle center and diametral counts follow by symmetry and equality in triangle inequality. Boundary-of-boundary relations force at least n-3 nonzero even tetra-defects; one triangle flip attains the exact gap and an explicit linear functional exposes the resulting endpoint. The standard-library verifier checks all 1,049,618 endpoint signs at n=3..6 and 22,618 additional exact identities/order cases; the proof, not enumeration, establishes the infinite claim.

originality.rationale: Primary hypergraphic zonotope literature proves the definition, lattice-volume and vertex/face acyclicity correspondences, not these standard-Euclidean outer-shell and sharp second-shell formulas. High-dimensional tournament literature studies degree sequences, acyclicity, and enumeration. A related recorded near-top acyclohedron theorem covers the n=5 radius/contact instance, but for n>=6 its dimension parameter n-3 differs from 2 and its result does not imply the present formulas. Targeted searches found no general competing theorem; this is a best-knowledge originality assessment, not historical certification.
residual_risks: The single n=5 outer-radius/contact case is already implied by the near-top acyclohedron finding; only n>=6 generalization and the sharp gap distinguish the new assertion.
Unindexed works or different normalizations may contain an equivalent all-dimensional formula; record search and available primary text do not prove absolute priority.
